jobs.title: Shopify Developer – D2C E-commerce
jobs.description:
**The Role**

You’ll own the brand’s D2C storefront end to end: theme, build, speed and checkout. The website is the brand’s highest-intent channel, so this is a hands-on build role, not a maintenance one. You’ll work with design, marketing and operations to ship new pages, launch product lines and keep the store fast through campaign and festive traffic.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, customise and maintain the Shopify theme in Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, turning design files into pixel-accurate, responsive pages
* Develop landing pages, product and collection templates, and campaign pages with fast turnaround
* Build reusable sections and blocks so marketing can update pages without a developer
* Manage storefront product data: variants, metafields, bundles and gifting flows
* Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals through image optimisation, script management and app clean-up
* Optimise the cart-to-checkout journey, including upsells, offer logic, discount rules, and payment and COD flows
* Run A/B tests across PDP, cart and checkout, and make winning variants permanent
* Implement and maintain tracking across GA4, GTM, Meta and Google Ads, with clean event data across the funnel
* Integrate third-party apps and backend systems (reviews, loyalty, subscriptions, WMS, ERP, shipping and returns) using Shopify APIs and webhooks
* Manage on-site SEO: site structure, schema markup, redirects and canonical tags
* Keep the store ready for sales and launches, and quickly fix live storefront and checkout issues

**What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on Shopify development experience, preferably at a consumer or D2C brand
* Strong command of Liquid, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, with direct work in theme code rather than only page builders
* Experience building custom themes and sections from design files on Shopify 2.0
* Working knowledge of the Shopify Admin and Storefront APIs, webhooks and app integrations
* Proven improvement of site speed, Core Web Vitals and conversion rate on a live store
* Familiarity with GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel and conversion event setup
* A strong eye for design detail and the ability to ship fast in a small team

**Good to Have**

* Shopify Plus, Shopify Functions or checkout extensions
* Headless storefront experience (Hydrogen, Next.js) or React front-end work
* Experience running subscription, loyalty or referral programmes on Shopify

**Description**
Are you passionate about building automation solutions that transform financial operations at scale? Join Transportation Financial Services (TFS) at Amazon, where you'll develop critical systems that power financial reporting and migrations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll tackle complex challenges in financial data processing, creating automated solutions that enable accurate book closures and seamless migrations.
  
  
As a SysDE on the TFS team, you'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve how Amazon manages transportation finances. You'll design device automations for large-scale migrations, build metric-generation systems that provide financial visibility, and create mechanisms that proactively address customer issues. Your work will enable business teams to operate more efficiently while ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of financial operations that support millions of deliveries worldwide.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you have experience in developing automation and operating complex systems in a production environment. You apply system engineering and development practices to ensure your automation is both reliable and correct. Your technical knowledge includes Linux systems and networking.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement automated solutions for device migrations and financial system transitions, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations
  
  
Develop metric generation systems and reporting tools that enable accurate financial book closures and provide visibility into transportation financial operations
  
  
Write clean, maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms while considering tradeoffs, limitations, and performance constraints
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues by addressing support tickets, diagnosing system problems, and implementing solutions that improve customer experience
  
  
Enhance existing features and build new capabilities that simplify adoption for internal customers and improve the overall reliability of financial systems
  
  
You should be able to triage situations quickly and work well with other engineers. We want you to be the best version of yourself – to continuously evolve and improve
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You'll start your day reviewing support tickets and prioritizing issues that impact financial reconciliation and ledger posting configurations accuracy. You might spend developing automated solutions for upcoming migrations, ingestions then collaborate with partner teams to enable new reports needed for monthly and quarterly book closures. You could be enhancing system features to make data adoption easier for business teams or debugging a complex issue in the metric generation pipeline. Throughout the day, you'll participate in code reviews, learn from experienced engineers, and contribute to technical discussions that shape the future of transportation financial systems.
  
  
**About The Team**
Transportation Financial Services (TFS) is at the heart of Amazon's transportation operations, building the systems that track, report, and analyze financial data across our global delivery network. Our team combines software engineering expertise with financial domain knowledge to create solutions that ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency. We value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, with team members ranging from early-career engineers to seasoned technical leaders.
  
  
We're focused on modernizing financial operations through automation and building scalable systems that support Amazon's growing transportation business. Our team culture emphasizes mentorship, continuous learning, and taking calculated approaches to solving complex problems. You'll have opportunities to work on meaningful projects that directly impact business decisions while developing your technical skills in cloud computing, data processing, and financial systems.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of systems development experience
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

The Opportunity: Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centers of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries. In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.

This team plays a key role in verifying and validating the products innovatively within bay-level solutions ensuring top-notch product quality which makes the organization one of the market leaders. Come join us in one of the best places to start your technical career and understand the engineering behind the practical realization of theoretical core concepts ranging from power system protection to digital substation solutions. You will be involved in thorough end-to-end RD testing of bay-level solutions and support software tools. In addition, you will also work on enhancing the Verification and validation processes using innovative automation paradigms and tools.

How will you make an impact

* To Verify validate of substation automation product - Numerical Relays.
* To Participate in test core team workshop to understand the product test requirements and performs software/domain test activities on system/product projects, including design, coding, and black box testing of software modules in line with the quality management system
* Developing new and adaptive design of test cases for system and product requirements. Report verify the test defect logs captured during the testing phase of the assigned product.
* Partnering well with a variety of different product stakeholder groups, including management at different levels, business analysts and developer's community.
* Technically responsible to ensure the mutual consistency and efficient integration of the several subsystems in modular, easy-to-maintain and extendible software that meets the product specification.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background

* Required bachelor's or master's degree in electrical / Electronic Engineering with 3-8 years of practical experience in Substation Automation.
* Should be technically sound in the field of protection and communication protocols used in substation (Ex. IEC 61850, DNP3, Sampled Values, Time Synchronization protocols)
* Should have knowledge on computer networks. OSI Layers, and different protocols in each layer is a plus.
* Should be proficient in any programming language such as Python/Java/C#.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle especially the Agile development method is a plus.
* Should have effective communication skills needed to collaborate with team members.
* Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

### Job Summary

Digital Engineer I. Location: Bangalore. Education Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer and Information Sciences; BE, MCA, Meng, BCA. Experience: Minimum 2 to 3 years of relevant hands-on work experience.

### Job Purpose

To design, develop, and deliver scalable digital solutions by collaborating with cross-functional teams, applying expertise in multiple programming languages, cloud platforms, and content management systems, while ensuring alignment with business requirements and industry best practices in an Agile environment.

### Role Description

* Develop technical solutions by understanding business requirements and proposing effective approaches
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure smooth delivery of digital solutions
* Work within Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies, supporting DevOps and Scrum Master roles as needed
* Manage multiple concurrent projects throughout the software development lifecycle
* Hands-on development using PHP, Java, NET, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C#
* Work with content Management Systems such as Sitecore, Acquia/Drupal, and Liferay
* Design and implement object-oriented solutions following best practices and design patterns
* Utilize Azure cloud platform and MS SQL databases for application development
* Use tools like UML design, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), monitoring (Kibana), and log management
* Debug applications and services efficiently to ensure high-quality output
* Review code and project deliverables to maintain compliance with industry standards
* Apply responsive and adaptive design principles for UI development
* Stay updated with industry trends and contribute to enterprise solution architecture including data and information design

### Key Skills

* Python
* Flask
* HTML
* CSS
* PHP
* Java
* NET
* JS
* C#
